title: Rigidity and flexibility under spectral Ricci lower bounds and mean-convex boundary
summary: We study Riemannian manifolds $(M^n,g)$ with mean-convex boundary whose Ricci curvature is nonnegative in a spectral sense. Our first main result is a sharp spectral extension of a rigidity theorem by Kasue: we prove that under the conditions \[ λ_1(-γΔ+\mathrm{Ric})\geq 0,\qquad H_{\partial M}\geq 0, \] and in the sharp range $0\leq γ<4$ if $n=2$, and $0\leqγ<\frac{n-1}{n-2}$ if $n\geq3$, a (possibly noncompact) complete manifold with disconnected boundary, with at least one compact boundary component, must split isometrically as a product $[0,L]\times Σ$.
